rules.outerSilhouette: Use the darkest local component ramp color by default; do not force RGB black.
rules.internalSeam: Use the second-darkest local component ramp color unless a deep separation is required.
rules.deepCrease: Near-black is allowed only at undersides, negative-space borders, deep creases, or high-contrast physical separations.
rules.localHue: Outline hue should stay near the adjacent material/component hue; target <= 25 degrees hue drift when saturation permits.
rules.valueSpacing: Boundary should normally be about 38-50 luma darker than adjacent interior, preserving authored shade order.
rules.lightDirection: Prefer upper regions lighter than lower regions; hats show a strong vertical bias (~20 luma) and almost no consistent left/right bias.
rules.geometry: Finish pass may change RGB only; alpha/silhouette and protected negative space never change.
rules.semanticOwnership: Choose outline/seam color from the neighboring semantic component, not from one global outline color.
